explainTr: Bu hafta sınav haftası: yeni konu yok, bildiklerini birleştiriyoruz. Zaman seçerken önce işaret kelimesine bak: yesterday/ago (past simple), since/for (present perfect), now/Look! (present continuous), tomorrow/next (will, going to).

Bir olay başka bir olaydan önce bittiyse past perfect (had + V3), başka bir olay sırasında sürüyorsa past continuous (was/were + -ing) kullanılır. 'As soon as, when, if' sonrasında gelecek anlamı olsa bile present simple gelir.
Sık hata: durum fiilleri (know, like, want, have=sahip) sürekli zamanda kullanılmaz: 'I know' denir, 'I am knowing' denmez.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'çalışıyorum' hem şu an hem süre için kullanılır. İngilizcede ayrım var: 'I am working' (şu an), 'I have been working here for two years' (hâlâ süren süre). 'Gitmiştim' ise past perfect: I had gone.

exercises.q: By the time Hafsa arrived, the interview ___.
exercises.whyTr: Başka bir geçmiş olaydan önce biten iş: past perfect (had + V3).

exercises.q: I ___ in Isparta until I was twenty-three.
exercises.whyTr: 'Until I was twenty-three' bitmiş bir dönem; past simple kullanılır.

exercises.q: She ___ for the principal when the phone rang.
exercises.whyTr: Başka bir olay araya girerken süren eylem: past continuous.

exercises.q: Hafsa ___ English for six years, and she still studies every day.
exercises.whyTr: Geçmişte başlayıp hâlâ süren eylem: present perfect continuous.

exercises.answer: Tomorrow I will arrive at the school early
exercises.whyTr: Gelecek plan için will + yalın fiil; zaman ifadesi başa gelebilir.
'Look!' şu an olan bir şeyi gösterir: present continuous.

exercises.q: If she ___ the job, she will start in September.
exercises.whyTr: If cümlesinde gelecek için present simple kullanılır (type 1).

exercises.q: The new teachers ___ their schedules yesterday.
exercises.whyTr: Yapan kişi önemli değil; past passive: was/were + V3.

exercises.answer: She said she had worked in a library before
exercises.whyTr: Reported speech'te past simple, past perfect'e kayar.
Yesterday bitmiş zaman: past simple; come - came.

reading.title: Hafsa's big day is tomorrow
reading.text:
Hafsa has been preparing for her substitute teacher interview for three weeks. Every morning she reads job descriptions, and every evening she practices answering questions with her son Emre. When she arrived in the United States six years ago, she could hardly order a coffee. Now she is ambitious and willing to learn anything.

Last Tuesday, while she was practicing in the kitchen, Linda knocked on the door. Linda had worked as a teaching assistant before she retired, so she knew exactly what principals look for. "They will ask about your strengths," Linda said. "Don't just say you are hardworking. Give an example. Tell them what you did, not only what you are."

Hafsa thought about it for a minute. By the time Emre came home, she had written three short stories about her past experience. In the first one, she was volunteering at a community center when a boy started crying because he couldn't read a sign. She sat with him until he understood every word. In the second, she organized a small cooking class for neighbors. In the third, she helped Emre's class prepare for a science fair last spring.

The interview is tomorrow at ten o'clock. If the principal asks about classroom management, Hafsa will say that she stays calm and keeps clear rules. She has already chosen her clothes, and she has printed her resume twice. She has also read the school's website carefully, so she can mention its values during the conversation. Tonight she is going to go to bed early, because she wants to sound confident and clear. Her plan is simple: smile, listen carefully, and answer honestly. If she makes a mistake, she will not panic. She will take a breath and try again.

"You have come a long way," Emre told her this morning. Hafsa laughed and nodded. "Yes, and tomorrow I will take one more step."

questions.q: What will Hafsa do if she makes a mistake?
options: Take a breath and try again

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Good morning, Hafsa. Thank you for coming. Please have a seat.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good morning, Ms. Rivera. Thank you for seeing me.

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Tell me about your experience. Have you ever worked with children?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes. For two years I have been volunteering at a community center, and I help with homework every Thursday.

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: That sounds useful. What would you do if two students started arguing during class?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I would stay calm and separate them first. Then I would talk to each one quietly.

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Good. Our substitutes also follow the sub plan the teacher leaves. Is that a problem for you?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Not at all. In my last job, I always followed instructions carefully.

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Excellent. We need someone for next Monday. Are you available?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, I am. I will be there at seven thirty.

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Wonderful. Mr. Brown will give you a badge and show you the classroom.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you very much. I won't forget this chance.

questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'I would stay calm and separate them first.'

writing.promptTr: Mülakattan sonra müdüre teşekkür e-postası yaz (120-180 kelime). Geçmiş, şimdiki ve gelecek zamanları karışık kullan: mülakatta ne konuştunuz, şu an neler hissediyorsun, ne yapacaksın.
writing.promptEn: Write a thank-you email to the principal after your interview (120-180 words). Use past, present and future tenses.
frames: Thank you for meeting with me yesterday. We talked about ...
I am very interested in ... because ...
If you choose me, I will ...
I look forward to hearing from you.
writing.model:
Dear Ms. Rivera,

Thank you for meeting with me yesterday. We talked about my experience with children and about the way I would handle a noisy classroom. I enjoyed our conversation very much, and I left the school feeling confident.

I have been volunteering at a community center for two years, so I understand how important patience and clear rules are. When I arrived at your office, I was a little nervous, but you made me feel welcome. Since then I have been thinking about the questions you asked, and I believe I gave honest answers.

I am very interested in the substitute position because I want to support students and teachers. If you choose me, I will follow every sub plan carefully and communicate with the office when I have a question. I will also arrive early, because I want every student to feel safe.

Thank you again for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Hafsa

Tüm cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor mu?

examSet.q: Right now, Hafsa ___ her notes.
examSet.whyTr: 'Right now' şu anı gösterir: present continuous.

examSet.q: We ___ each other for ten years.
examSet.whyTr: Süre (for ten years) + durum fiili: present perfect; know sürekli şekil almaz.

examSet.q: When I called, she ___ dinner.
examSet.whyTr: Telefon çalarken süren eylem: past continuous.

examSet.q: I will call you as soon as I ___ the school.
examSet.whyTr: as soon as sonrası gelecek için present simple kullanılır.

examSet.q: If I had more time, I ___ a second course.
examSet.whyTr: Gerçek dışı şimdiki durum (type 2): would + yalın fiil.

examSet.q: I wish I ___ speak Spanish.
examSet.whyTr: Şimdiki istek/pişmanlık: wish + past form (could).

examSet.q: The forms ___ by the secretary this morning.
examSet.whyTr: Forms çoğul ve iş yapılmış: were checked (past passive).

examSet.q: He asked me where I ___.
examSet.whyTr: Reported question düz cümle sırasıyla: where I lived.

examSet.q: You ___ wear a uniform; it is optional.
examSet.whyTr: Zorunlu değil = don't have to; mustn't yasaktır.

examSet.q: She isn't answering. She ___ have left already.
examSet.whyTr: Güçlü çıkarım (geçmiş): must have + V3.

examSet.q: Which word is closest in meaning to "outstanding"?
examSet.whyTr: Outstanding = excellent (çok iyi).

examSet.q: Which word is closest in meaning to "enhance"?
examSet.whyTr: Enhance = improve.

examSet.q: What is the opposite of "willing"?
examSet.whyTr: Willing'in zıttı reluctant (isteksiz).

examSet.q: What is the opposite of "strengthen"?
examSet.whyTr: Strengthen'in zıttı weaken.

examSet.q: Her ___ at the community center impressed the principal.
examSet.whyTr: Boşlukta çoğul isim lazım: achievements.

examSet.q: She decided ___ for the substitute position.
examSet.whyTr: decide + to + fiil.

examSet.q: The woman ___ interviewed me was very kind.
examSet.whyTr: Kişi için özne konumunda 'who'.

examSet.q: ___ she was nervous, she answered every question clearly.
examSet.whyTr: Zıtlık + tam cümle: Although.
